tools.name: basic_lookup
tools.description: Public company profile: summary plus firmographics (industry, HQ city/country, founded year, employee count and size range, ticker, LinkedIn/X), each field with source, source_url, checked_at and confidence, from Wikidata, Wikipedia, the company homepage and SEC EDGAR. Unknown fields are null, never

tools.name: enriched_lookup
tools.description: Prospecting record: everything in basic_lookup plus buying signals (90 days of news, SEC filings), open roles from public job boards, a 0-100 ICP fit score with stated reasons (optional icp input), a sales brief built only from cited facts, recommended next actions and roles to target (no invented n

tools.name: prospect_brief
tools.description: Full sales prospect brief for one company: overview, positioning, likely needs and talking points, built from public sources with URLs. Price: $3.00 USDC on Base per call via x402; this MCP call returns payment instructions and the paid HTTP route POST /v1/deep returns the brief. Read-only.

tools.name: run_named_tool
tools.description: Run one named public-source analysis: research_company, research_person, find_decision_makers, analyze_marketing_opportunity, identify_buying_signals, enrich_prospect, score_prospect or generate_prospect_brief. Fields with no verified public source come back as unknown rather than guessed. Price: $0

tools.name: email_lookup
tools.description: Find one person's work email at a company domain. Returns the address, whether it was found publicly or inferred from the company's pattern, Hunter's real verification status (valid, accept_all, unknown, invalid), a confidence score, the pages it was seen on and a recommendation. Price: $0.08 USDC o

tools.name: find_emails_batch
tools.description: Find work emails for 1-25 people in one call, for cleaning a whole prospect list. Each result has exactly the same fields and recommendation labels as email_lookup (found vs inferred, Hunter's real status, score, sources, send / send_with_caution / verify_first / do_not_send), returned in input orde

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup, find_emails_batch · Private data: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, find_emails_batch · Public sink: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup, find_emails_batch · Destructive: run_named_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup, find_emails_batch · Private data: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, find_emails_batch · Public sink: basic_lookup, enriched_lookup, prospect_brief, run_named_tool, email_lookup, find_emails_batch · Destructive: run_named_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
